name: Shark Chariot
text: Keywords: Can't Block, Ephemeral, Last Breath. Last Breath: The next time an Ephemeral ally attacks, revive me attacking.

name: Targon's Peak
text: Keywords: Landmark. Round Start: Reduce the cost of a random card in ALL players' hands to 0 this round.

name: Starshaping
text: Invoke a Celestial card that costs 7 or more, then heal an ally or your Nexus 5.

name: Scattered Pod
text: Play: Draw a Slow, Fast, or Burst spell. Enlightened: I have Elusive.

name: Stoneweaving
text: Manifest a landmark you can afford.

name: Avatar of the Tides
text: Keywords: Imbue. If you would get a mana gem, instead refill your spell mana. When you play a spell, create in hand a random spell that costs 3 or less and grant it Fleeting.

name: Mikhael's Blessing
text: Grant an ally +1|+2 and remove all negative keywords from it.

name: Skrappy's Partsapalooza
text: Keywords: Landmark. When I'm discarded, summon me. When you summon a Mecha Yordle, grant it a random keyword.

name: The Darkin Fan
text: Keywords: Equipment. Attack: Summon an attacking Dragonling. You may spend 9 mana to play me as Praa the Breachwalker.

name: Bloodcursed Harpy
text: Keywords: Scout. Play: Equip me with an equipment that costs 2 or less from hand. The first time I would die while Equipped, fully heal me and destroy the equipment instead.

name: Prize Fight
text: An ally and an enemy strike each other. They can't drop below 1 Health from this strike.

name: Ingvar the Younger
text: Play: Pick an ally. Grant it and all other allies that share a subtype with it +1|+1 or Manifest a follower that shares a subtype with it.

name: Volibear (level 2)
text: Keywords: Overwhelm, Missing Translation. Play or Attack: Play Relentless Storm 3 times. Each one targets a different random enemy or the enemy Nexus if none. Other allies have Overwhelm.

name: Help, Pix!
text: Keywords: Focus, Fleeting. Give an ally Barrier or an enemy Vulnerable this round.

name: Blade
text: Obliterate me when I leave combat.

name: Akshan's Grappling Hook
text: Keywords: Slow. An ally you've targeted this round strikes an enemy. Create an Akshan in your deck.

name: Lissandra's Entomb
text: Keywords: Fast. Obliterate a unit to summon a Frozen Tomb in place with the unit stored inside. Create a Lissandra in your deck.

name: Seraphine's High Note
text: Keywords: Fast. Deal 2 to a unit. If you've played 6+ other new spells this game, deal 1 to another unit. Create a Seraphine in your deck.

name: Taarosh
text: Keywords: Fearsome. Each round, the first time I attack, fill your attackers with revived Ephemeral copies of the strongest followers you've slain this game.
